text: 金十数据10月23日讯，2026年10月23日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见了意大利前总理、欧央行前行长马里奥·德拉吉，美中关系全国委员会会长斯蒂芬·欧伦斯，城堡证券首席执行官赵鹏。双方围绕全球经济形势、金融市场动态、中国宏观经济政策等议题进行了交流。中国人民银行副行长宣昌能参加会见。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 23: On October 23, 2026, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with former Italian Prime Minister and former ECB President Mario Draghi, National Committee on U.S.-China Relations President Stephen Orlins, and Citadel Securities CEO Peng Zhao. The two sides exchanged views on the global economic situation, financial market developments, China's macroeconomic policies and other topics. PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended the meeting.
